export const LOCALES = ['en', 'pt-BR'] as const
export type Locale = (typeof LOCALES)[number]

export type WeatherKey = 'clear' | 'cloudy' | 'rainy' | 'thunder' | 'storm'

export type Messages = {
  /** Decimal separator used when abbreviating token counts. */
  decimal: string
  weather: Record<WeatherKey, string>
  tokensInContext: string
  tokensPerTurn: string
  last: string
  session: string
  cacheRead: (tokens: string) => string
  hide: string
  commandDescription: string
  hidden: (command: string) => string
  shown: string
}

export const MESSAGES: Record<Locale, Messages> = {
  en: {
    decimal: '.',
    weather: {
      clear: 'Clear skies',
      cloudy: 'Cloudy',
      rainy: 'Rainy',
      thunder: 'Thunder',
      storm: 'Storm',
    },
    tokensInContext: 'tokens in context',
    tokensPerTurn: 'Tokens per turn',
    last: 'last',
    session: 'session',
    cacheRead: tokens => `+${tokens} read from cache`,
    hide: 'Hide',
    commandDescription: 'Show or hide the context weather band',
    hidden: command => `Context weather band hidden. Run /${command} to show it again.`,
    shown: 'Context weather band shown.',
  },
  'pt-BR': {
    decimal: ',',
    weather: {
      clear: 'Céu aberto',
      cloudy: 'Nublado',
      rainy: 'Chuvoso',
      thunder: 'Trovoadas',
      storm: 'Tempestade',
    },
    tokensInContext: 'tokens no contexto',
    tokensPerTurn: 'Tokens por interação',
    last: 'última',
    session: 'sessão',
    cacheRead: tokens => `+${tokens} relidos do cache`,
    hide: 'Ocultar',
    commandDescription: 'Mostra ou oculta a faixa do clima do contexto',
    hidden: command => `Faixa do clima oculta. /${command} mostra de novo.`,
    shown: 'Faixa do clima visível.',
  },
}

/** Maps free text ("pt_BR.UTF-8", "Portuguese", "português", "en-US") to a supported locale. */
export function localeFromText(text: string | undefined): Locale | undefined {
  if (!text) return undefined
  const t = text.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (/^pt([-_.]|$)/.test(t) || t.includes('portug')) return 'pt-BR'
  if (/^en([-_.]|$)/.test(t) || t.includes('english') || t.includes('ingl')) return 'en'
  return undefined
}

/**
 * The locale the band is drawn in: the mod's `language` option when it names a
 * locale; on `auto`, the first source that maps to one (the Claude Code
 * `language` setting, then the `LANG` variable); English otherwise.
 */
export function resolveLocale(option: unknown, settingsLanguage: unknown, lang: string | undefined): Locale {
  if (typeof option === 'string' && (LOCALES as readonly string[]).includes(option)) return option as Locale
  return localeFromText(typeof settingsLanguage === 'string' ? settingsLanguage : undefined) ?? localeFromText(lang) ?? 'en'
}
